scope: Independent review of all ten rows and twenty full KWICs for exact evidence, Chan deployment, lexical-unit boundary, variants, distinct-work support, and disposition.

cohortFindings.exactEvidence: PASS — zc.verify accepts all twenty stored KWICs at their cited loci; every title and workId matches the frozen manifest.
cohortFindings.workIndependence: PASS — each admitted row has evidence from two distinct workIds; none obtains multi-source status from split volumes or duplicate editions of one work.
cohortFindings.variantHandling: PASS — the ledger distinguishes the unattested Japanese punctuation forms 土曠人稀、相逢者少 and 一點水墨、兩處成龍 from their exact comma forms (89/56 works and 91/63 works), and the unattested 縁 graph from exact 養子之緣 (106/50 works).
cohortFindings.semanticBoundary: PASS — all ten strings have an observable recurring Chan job in the full cases; none is admitted merely because it occurs in narration or verse.

reviews.finding: One case explicitly calls the exchange making trouble where none exists; another wields the same formula as a direct rebuke. It recurs as an interview verdict, not generic narration.
Both records use the two-lips image to challenge or dismiss mere verbal activity in public exchange. The whole phrase carries the diagnostic job.
Both clauses are delivered together as the answer and then become the object of the encounter's appraisal. The exact corpus punctuation is comma, not the queue's Japanese separator.
The line is repeatedly raised as the case-bearing answer about what was knocked down; the phrase is quoted and tested rather than merely describing a fall.
The paired image is deployed intact as a capping appraisal of the case in two independent works. Its two balanced clauses form the lexical unit; the corpus uses comma punctuation.
Both witnesses use the phrase as an explicit verdict on a participant knowingly transgressing, one inside case criticism and one in a public exchange. It is a recurrent adjudicative formula.

The exact traditional graph 緣 is used in two distinct works to classify the same case response as the device or consideration used in raising a child. The queue's 縁 graph is correctly treated as unattested rather than silently normalized.
Dahui deploys the formula in two distinct works as an explicit warning/cap: one who recognizes the law or standard is wary. It is spoken evaluative language, not descriptive prose.
Both witnesses deliberately raise the complete formula as a doctrinal claim and subject it to Chan questioning or appraisal. The component is stable across independent works.
The sword-tree and knife-mountain pair is wielded in separate Chan addresses as the punitive ordeal against which the audience or practitioner is tested, not as incidental cosmological inventory.
